How to change the Share a Link and Discuss button text?

For the sidebar:

a.btn-whoaverse.btn-block.contribute.submit-link {
 font-size: 0;
}
a.btn-whoaverse.btn-block.contribute.submit-link:after {
 font-size: 12px;
 content: "Click to submit a link!";
}
a.btn-whoaverse.btn-block.contribute.submit-text {
 font-size: 0;
}
a.btn-whoaverse.btn-block.contribute.submit-text:after {
 font-size: 12px;
 content: "Start a discussion";
}

For the top menu buttons:

.tabmenu a.contribute.submit-link {
 font-size: 0;
 background: none;
 border: 0;
 border-width: 0;
}
.tabmenu a.contribute.submit-link:after {
 content: "Submit a link here!";
 font-size: 12px;
 background: #bbe5ff;
 background: -webkit-linear-gradient(top,#bbe5ff,#a6ddff);
 background: -moz-linear-gradient(top,#bbe5ff,#a6ddff);
 background: -ms-linear-gradient(top,#bbe5ff,#a6ddff);
 background: -o-linear-gradient(top,#bbe5ff,#a6ddff);
 border: solid #70b7e3;
 border-width: 1px 1px 2px;
 border-radius: 3px;
 padding: 4px 8px;
}
.tabmenu a.contribute.submit-text {
 font-size: 0;
 background: none;
 border: 0;
 border-width: 0;
}
.tabmenu a.contribute.submit-text:after {
 content: "Start a discussion";
 font-size: 12px;
 background: #bbe5ff;
 background: -webkit-linear-gradient(top,#bbe5ff,#a6ddff);
 background: -moz-linear-gradient(top,#bbe5ff,#a6ddff);
 background: -ms-linear-gradient(top,#bbe5ff,#a6ddff);
 background: -o-linear-gradient(top,#bbe5ff,#a6ddff);
 border: solid #70b7e3;
 border-width: 1px 1px 2px;
 border-radius: 3px;
 padding: 4px 8px;
}

Note that you can effectively combine certain styles if you want to use both of these, but if you only want to change a single button, the code provided will help you do that; just delete the code you don't want.
